plugins.name: File Mode
plugins.description: For models requested with a configurable prefix (default file-), replaces the text of the new user turn with file names answered by a read_message call the model has already made, and turns the model's submit_reply tool call back into a plain text reply. Works across OpenAI-compatible, Codex, Claude and Gemini upstreams. Keeps the last few file-mode requests in memory (inbound and reply verdicts) for a management menu page.
plugins.author: yuanwangz

zh-CN.description: 模型名带指定前缀（默认 file-）时，把本轮新用户消息的正文换成文件名，并补上一次「模型已调用 read_message」及其返回（正文在返回里），并把模型的 submit_reply 工具调用还原成普通文字回复。上游为 OpenAI 兼容、Codex、Claude、Gemini 均可用。在内存里保留最近几条文件模式请求（入站处理和回复是否正常），可在管理界面的插件菜单查看。
zh-CN.name: 文件模式
